requirements.text: A student dashboard displaying borrowed items, due dates, current status, fines accrued, and reservation history.
A system for students to manage their borrowing, renewals, and online room bookings easily.
Tools for staff to manage inventory with features for adding, updating, and retiring items.
Reporting capabilities for usage metrics, including loan volumes, room utilization, and fine revenue trends.
System must integrate seamlessly with the existing student record system.
System must comply with GDPR for customer data storage.
There is a limited budget for the project.
Data migration from the legacy system must ensure no critical data is lost.
System must conform to accessibility standards for all students, including those with disabilities.
